live_only_reason: This case tests whether a local date preference is incorrectly promoted to a global specialist rule; the v0 text-asset runner has no skill-promotion or policy-review action.

request.idea: Evaluate a style preference about dates without promoting it globally.

sources.text: The owner dislikes excess dates in this specific personal newsletter, while dates remain useful in news, research, and technical reports. This is a local preference, not a global rule.
